description: Constants and rules of the ЭВС calculation, each with its citation. Formulas are written in plain text with the book's symbols; docs/methods/evs.md explains the order of steps. The solver reads constants from here instead of hard-coding them.

items.name: Общее сопротивление: последовательное соединение групп из попарно-параллельных ЭД
Общее сопротивление: параллельно-пучковая сеть

symbols.r_uch: сопротивление участкового провода ОДНОЙ ветви (L_uch = L_v, длина одной ветви)

notes: RPR art. 112 formula (7) (original scan): r_uch belongs to ONE branch.
Branches must have about equal length and resistance.

items.name: Общее сопротивление: смешанная сеть

sources.locator: формула (4.12), (4.13): R_общ = R_м + [R_с + R_у + n2(R_эд + R_к)]/m1; I >= m·I_г
слайд «Расчёт ЭВС со смешанным соединением»: R = Rм + (Rуч + mRд)/n, Rуч относится ко всем участкам одной ветви

notes: RPR art. 113 formula (8) (original scan, p. 103): r_uch is the resistance of ALL section wires of one branch; I = n*i by formula (6) with i = 1 А per branch (art. 67). Open sources (Лукьянов (4.12)-(4.13), ПГУПС slide) agree.
Same number m of detonators in every branch (art. 113). Otherwise only the general circuit solver applies.
With n = 1 it reduces to the series formula, with m = 1 to the parallel-bundle formula (7).

symbols.m: число последовательно соединённых ЭД в ветви
symbols.r_uch: сопротивление участковых (и соединительных) проводов ОДНОЙ ветви

items.name: Потребный ток: последовательная сеть
notes: Matches the group current of Table 1.2 for ЭДП (1 / 1,5 А); for ЭД-8 Table 1.2 gives 1 / 2,5 А. The method text does not distinguish detonator types.

symbols.i: расчётный ток одиночного ЭД (detonators.json: i_calc_single_dc / i_calc_single_ac)

items.name: Потребный ток: смешанная сеть
notes: Current in each branch as for a series network (1,0 / 1,5 А).
Лукьянов (4.13): I >= m·I_г, the same rule.

items.name: Ограничение для слаботочных источников
items.rule: Sources that give up to 1-1,5 А: parallel and mixed schemes are not allowed.

items.name: Один тип и одна партия ЭД в последовательной сети
items.rule: Detonators of different types or batches must not be mixed in one series network.

items.name: Проверка конденсаторной машинки
items.rule: For capacitor machines only two parameters are checked: total resistance R and the number of detonators (pairs) for the chosen scheme, against the machine table.
notes: The Praktikum (sheets 12, 14) also prints required vs nominal voltage in the comparison table; the verdict rests on count and resistance.

items.name: Подбор числа источников (кроме конденсаторных машинок)
items.formula: series: m >= U / U_src (10);  parallel: n >= I / I_src (11)
items.rule: If the source gives the current but not the voltage, connect k equal sources in series; if it does not give the current, connect n in parallel.
notes: User decision 2026-11-15 (revised): for accumulators I_src is the long-mode discharge current, as in RPR-69 art. 117 (3СТ-60: 10-hour current 6,0 А from Table 14): acid batteries i_10h; alkaline batteries (Table 13, no 10-hour column) i_8h; web batteries 6СТ-75 / 6СТ-190 i_10h = C10 / 10.
U_src for accumulators: the voltage of the same mode (Table 14: u_10h; Table 13: u_initial at the start, u_8h_end at the end of discharge). The starter / 1-hour values are kept for reference only.

items.name: Потребное количество батарей 70-АМЦГ / 100-АМЦГ (табл. 12)
notes: Condition (konspekt2021 sheet 39, same table): the table is made for a network of single-core wire with a total length up to 1000 м. In RPR-69.pdf the sentence before Table 12 is not on sheet 79 (probably on a page lost in the retyped edition).
Verified by the user against the printed page in tmp/review.html (2026-11-15): Table 12.

items.name: Запас длины проводов (слабина)
notes: RPR art. 121 (p. 109): wires are laid with 10-15 % slack of the distance between connected points; art. 123 (p. 113): wire pieces are cut 10-15 % longer than nominal.
User decision 2026-11-15: the margin is applied to main and to section wires only when the user switches it on; the factor is editable, default 1,125.

items.name: Расстояние от узла безопасности до первого заряда
notes: Problem 2 adds 25 m in the formula but says '50 м — длина проводов от узла безопасности до зарядов'; see tests/golden/evs_cases.json prakt2023_p2.

items.name: Грозозащитный прибор ГЗУ
notes: One ГЗУ before each detonator.

items.name: ГЗУ с машинками КПМ-1 и КПМ-2
items.rule: U < 60 В: КПМ-1 / КПМ-2 usable without extra resistor. Otherwise add at least r_add_min to the main line, keeping the total within the machine limit.
notes: (17) read from the page image; (18) from the text layer, matches the image layout. Only for КПМ-1 and КПМ-2.

items.name: Ступенчатое присоединение ветвей при конденсаторных машинках
items.rule: With capacitor machines, parallel branches may be attached to the main wires stepwise if adjacent branches are no more than 4-6 м apart. Calculated as art. 113; at most 4 parallel branches; equal number of detonators in every branch; total resistance within the parallel limits of Tables 7-9.

items.name: Подбор источника тока (ст. 115)
items.rule: ПМ-1: series only, check total R (<= 290 Ом). КПМ-1, КПМ-2: series, parallel or mixed per art. 76, 81, 114 (machine tables). Other sources: required U and I from art. 110-113. Power stations and mains: nominal characteristics. Accumulators, dry cells and batteries: art. 116-120.

items.name: Напряжение источника под нагрузкой (ст. 116)

symbols.E0: ЭДС (свежие батареи: табл. 11, или вольтметр без нагрузки)

items.rule: A source with U_src >= U and current >= I is suitable.

items.name: Смешанное соединение источников (ст. 119-120)
items.formula: N = m*n (13);  if U_src unknown: m >= 2*I*R/E0 (14), n >= 2*I*R0/E0 (15);  check I_bat = m*E0 / (R + m*R0/n) >= I (16)
notes: The art. 119 example cites 'формула (14)' for N = m*n; it is formula (13).

items.name: Внутреннее сопротивление батареи (ст. 92)
items.formula: by known current: R0 = (U1 - U2)/i  (1);  by known external resistance: R0 = (U1 - U2)/U2 * R  (2)
notes: For user-defined batteries: lets the user enter measured U1, U2 and i (or R).
